why: To hear the notes you play, Fermata listens through the microphone; the sound never leaves this device.
asking: Your browser is asking whether Fermata may use the microphone.
on: Play the notes one at a time and let each one ring.

problem.refused: The microphone is blocked for Fermata. To allow it, open this site's settings (beside the address, or your phone's settings for this browser). You can still answer on the screen.
problem.missing: No microphone was found on this device. You can still answer on the screen.
problem.unsupported: This browser can't use a microphone here. You can still answer on the screen.
problem.busy: The microphone couldn't start: another app may be using it. You can still answer on the screen.
problem.failed: The microphone couldn't start. You can still answer on the screen.
problem.hidden: Listening stopped because Fermata was no longer on screen (for example, you switched to another app or tab). Turn on “Use my instrument” again to go on.
problem.ended: The microphone was disconnected, so listening stopped. You can still answer on the screen.
